unlisted_practices: Using SHAP feature attribution and cross-model explanation consistency to assess interpretability of predictive models
Using an LLM as a post hoc layer to translate model outputs into clinician-readable explanations
Evaluating calibration and decision curve analysis alongside discrimination for a postoperative analgesia risk model

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively evaluates an explainable AI pipeline including predictive models and an LLM interpretation layer on a cohort of 197 surgical patients, but it does not compare outcomes with versus without a deployment practice.
